question: Which of the following is responsible for bringing western disturbances from the Mediterranean region into the Indian subcontinent?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Jet stream**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Jet stream:**

 
 
• Jet streams are fast-flowing, narrow air currents in the upper levels of the atmosphere.
 
• They are formed due to temperature differences between different air masses.
 
• The subtropical jet stream is a key factor in bringing western disturbances to India.
 
• These disturbances are extra-tropical cyclones that originate in the Mediterranean region.
 
• The jet stream acts as a carrier, steering these disturbances eastward towards the Indian subcontinent.
